This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

Package Overview

energyr is an R data package providing Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) datasets from 1996–2014. It exports 7 lazy-loaded datasets: electric, gas, oil, hydropower, lng, pipeline, and storage. There are no exported functions — only documented data objects.

Common Commands

Development workflow (preferred)

devtools::load_all()     # Load package for interactive development
devtools::document()     # Regenerate roxygen2 docs (man/ and NAMESPACE)
devtools::check()        # Full R CMD check
devtools::test()         # Run all tests

Run a single test file

testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/test-electric.R")

Build and check from shell

R CMD build .
R CMD check energyr_*.tar.gz

Regenerate README.md from README.Rmd

rmarkdown::render("README.Rmd")

Build pkgdown documentation site

pkgdown::build_site()

Architecture

Data layer

All datasets live in data/*.rda (compressed binary). Their roxygen2 documentation is in R/<dataset>.R. The NAMESPACE file is auto-generated by roxygen2 and contains no explicit exports — datasets are made available via lazy loading declared in DESCRIPTION (LazyData: true).

Documentation

  • R/energyr.R — package-level @docType package stub
  • R/<dataset>.R — one file per dataset, each containing only roxygen2 comments (@format, @source, @examples)
  • man/ — auto-generated; never edit by hand

Tests

tests/testthat/test-<dataset>.R — one file per dataset. Tests check: dataset loads, correct class (data.frame), expected column names, column types, dimensions, and no NAs in key fields.

CI

  • .github/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml — runs rcmdcheck on macOS/Windows/Ubuntu across R devel, release, and oldrel-1
  • .github/workflows/test-coverage.yaml — Codecov integration via covr
  • .github/workflows/pkgdown.yaml — deploys docs to GitHub Pages

Data Pipeline (data-raw/)

Dataset scripts live in data-raw/. Each script reads a source CSV from inst/extdata/, processes it, and saves the .rda via usethis::use_data(overwrite = TRUE). Three datasets (hydropower, lng, storage) also geocode using tidygeocoder with the free OSM/Nominatim provider.

Prerequisites: install.packages(c("here", "tidygeocoder", "usethis"))

To regenerate all datasets:

source("data-raw/update_all.R")

To regenerate a single dataset:

source("data-raw/electric.R")    # or gas, oil, pipeline — no geocoding, < 5 sec
source("data-raw/lng.R")         # ~1 min  (~39 OSM geocode calls)
source("data-raw/storage.R")     # ~10 min (~223 OSM geocode calls)
source("data-raw/hydropower.R")  # ~30 min (~1030 OSM geocode calls)

Source CSVs must be present in inst/extdata/ before running. See each script’s header comment for the FERC download URL.

Adding or Updating a Dataset

  1. Place the source CSV in inst/extdata/<name>.csv.
  2. Create or update data-raw/<name>.R following the existing script pattern.
  3. Run the script to produce data/<name>.rda.
  4. Edit R/<name>.R with roxygen2 @format, @source, and @examples tags.
  5. Add or update tests/testthat/test-<name>.R with column and type checks.
  6. Run devtools::document() then devtools::check().
